description: Digest-bound PatchBundle review delivery and lifecycle over fixtures. Historical recipes traverse only as diagnostic-only system fixtures on isolated copies; no public mutation and no historical value reuse.

implementation.seam: new pure package internal/wcncpreview reusing proposal patch bindings and exact-revert transactions

coverage: draft creation with all protocol sections and authority statement

tampered patch bytes reject before review
